subject: SIG onboarding: SOC2/HIPAA scope and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintegral.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintegral.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire — SIG start and SOC 2 / HIPAA scope

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We're preparing a short vendor security intake for Redwood as part of our pilot procurement. Two quick asks to get the SIG rolling:  

1) Can you confirm current SOC 2 posture (Type I vs Type II; date range if applicable) and an ETA if Type II is in progress?
2) Do you support HIPAA (do you sign a BAA) and do you provide architecture docs showing PHI handling?
3) Which questionnaire do you prefer to complete for an initial pass — the full SIG, CAIQ, or a short custom form? Our security team prefers SIG but will accept CAIQ-lite if you already have mappings.
4) Preferred delivery method for evidence (secure Drive link, Box, ShareFile) and any constraints around redaction.

I've attached our vendor intake form for context (vendor_intake_form.pdf). If you can reply with a short timeline for answers and who on your side will own the artifacts, that would be great.

We hope to have an initial pass completed in the next 10 business days if possible — but happy to coordinate around your team's availability.

Thanks,
Alice Wong
Security Program Manager
Fintegral AI
Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintegral.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire — SIG start and SOC 2 / HIPAA scope

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear asks and the intake form. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment:  

Recap:
- Redwood is happy to start with the SIG (we can also provide CAIQ mappings if you prefer).
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I report current to Jun 2026 and are in progress on Type II (expected completion Q1 2027). We can share interim evidence and our control narratives for the in-scope systems.
- HIPAA / PHI: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workflows and we do sign BAAs for customers using PHI. For vendor onboarding we'll surface architecture diagrams and PHI-handling notes.

Owners (proposed):
- Jordan Blake (cc) will own technical evidence: encryption, network diagram, encryption keys/KMS details.
- Soojin Lee (cc) will own compliance artifacts and policy-level docs (SOC control mapping, incident response).
- I'll coordinate the timeline and shepherd the SIG completion with your team.

Proposed timeline and delivery:
1) Confirm preferred format for evidence delivery (Google Drive shared folder or secure ShareFile) — please confirm.
2) We'll complete draft SIG answers and a short control narrative in ~5 business days after receipt of your preferred delivery details.
3) We'll assemble an evidence bundle (documents referenced in answers) within ~10 business days. If you need CAIQ-lite first, we can do that in 3 business days.

Attachments we plan to include: SIG-template.pdf (our working copy), SOC2-summary.pdf (control list + progress notes), network-diagram.png (high level). Please let us know if you require signed attestations or additional formats.

Next steps for you: confirm evidence delivery method and whether CAIQ-lite is acceptable for an initial pass. Once we have that, Jordan and Soojin will start compiling items.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Chloe M. | +1 415-555-0198
Attachments: SIG-template.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintegral.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire — SIG start and SOC 2 / HIPAA scope

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 5:10 PM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment: 

Thanks Chloe — adding a few technical clarifications from the SE side to make sure we pull the right artifacts:  

- Data classes: can you confirm whether Fintegral will send PHI to Redwood in production or only pseudonymized PII? This affects our evidence selection (full PHI handling docs vs. pseudonymization notes).
- Environments in scope: please confirm if staging/dev environments are in scope for the SIG or just prod. We typically provide prod controls and note dev/staging differences.
- KMS / key custody: we support both customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments and Redwood-managed keys for Hosted. Please confirm which you expect to use for this pilot.
- Third-party subprocessors: we'll include a current subprocessor list (third_party_subprocessors.csv) and can highlight major cloud providers and telemetry processors.

I'll attach a high-level network diagram and the SOC 2 summary doc we referenced so you can circulate to your reviewers.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: network-diagram.png; soc2-summary.pdf
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintegral.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire — SIG start and SOC 2 / HIPAA scope

Chloe / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick responses and helpful detail. A few clarifications from our side:  

- Delivery method: secure Google Drive shared folder works best for us (we'll provide a link and specific upload access).
- Questionnaire: we prefer the SIG for a full assessment. CAIQ-lite is fine as a first pass only if you think it speeds things up.
- Data class: Fintegral will plan to send PII and PHI for the pilot (PHI limited to de-identified clinical notes and lab results — but still requires BAA-level controls).
- Environments: production only in scope for now.
- KMS: for the pilot we expect Redwood-managed keys on hosted environment; please document encryption-at-rest policies and KMS roles.

Timeline: we agree to draft SIG answers in 7 business days and the full evidence bundle in 14 business days (target dates below once we share the Drive link). Interim SOC 2 artifacts are acceptable while Type II completes.

If you can start by creating the shared folder and dropping the SIG-template.pdf + the SOC2-summary, we'll route to our security review. We'll also open a ticket with procurement for the BAA — procurement@fintegral.ai will follow up with legal.

Appreciate it — we'll watch for the Drive link.

Best,
Alice Wong
Security Program Manager
Fintegral AI
